title: Create External SR from List Page
description: Test the creation of a Service Report from the Service Reports List Page by a Service Manager.
preconditions: Service Manager has SR create permission for the department.
steps_summary: Navigate to the Service Reports module.
Enter SR Name and confirm today's date.
Search for and select a Ticket.
expected_result: SR is created in To Do status with (External) chip visible.

title: Create Internal SR from Within Ticket
description: Test the creation of an Internal Service Report from within a Ticket by a Service Engineer.
preconditions: Service Engineer has SR create permission for the department.
Ticket is in a non-terminal status.
steps_summary: Open a Ticket in In Progress status.
Navigate to the Service Reports tab.
expected_result: SR is created in To Do status with (Internal) chip. CU cannot see this SR.

title: Create SR Alongside Appointment
description: Test creating a Service Report alongside an Appointment for an existing Ticket by a Service Manager.
preconditions: Service Manager has SR create permission for the department.
Existing Ticket is in a non-terminal status.
steps_summary: Select SR Type: Time & Material and Visibility: External.
expected_result: Both the appointment and the SR are created. The SR is linked to the appointment in To Do status.

title: Validate Required SR Type
description: Ensure that the Service Report Type field is required and shows an error if not selected.
steps_summary: Open the Create Service Report form.
Leave the SR Type field blank.
expected_result: Validation error is displayed for the SR Type field.

title: Validate Required SR Name
description: Ensure that the Service Report Name field is required and shows an error if not entered.
steps_summary: Open the Create Service Report form.
Leave the SR Name field blank.
expected_result: Validation error is displayed for the SR Name field.

title: Validate Required SR Date
description: Ensure that the Service Report Date field is required and shows an error if not selected.
steps_summary: Open the Create Service Report form.
expected_result: Validation error is displayed for the SR Date field.

title: Validate Required Ticket Selection
description: Ensure that the Ticket field is required and shows an error if not selected when creating from the list page.
steps_summary: Open the Create Service Report form from the list page.
expected_result: Validation error is displayed for the Ticket field.

title: Validate Required Assignee Selection
description: Ensure that at least one Assignee is required and shows an error if not selected.
steps_summary: Open the Create Service Report form.
expected_result: Validation error is displayed for the Assignee field.

title: Ticket Selection Auto-populates Organization
description: Verify that selecting a Ticket auto-populates the Organization field.
steps_summary: Open the Create Service Report form.
expected_result: Organization field is auto-populated based on the selected Ticket.

title: Ticket Selection Auto-populates Organization User
description: Verify that selecting a Ticket auto-populates the Organization User field.
steps_summary: Open the Create Service Report form.
expected_result: Organization User field is auto-populated based on the selected Ticket.

title: Internal Only Toggle Affects Workflow Path
description: Verify that toggling Internal Only affects the SR's workflow path.
steps_summary: Open the Create Service Report form.
expected_result: SR follows the internal_only workflow path.

title: Custom Form Auto-Attachment Based on Ticket and Flow
description: Verify that a custom form is auto-attached based on the Ticket's service type and selected report_flow.
preconditions: Custom form is configured for the Ticket's service type and flow.
steps_summary: Open the Create Service Report form.
Select a Ticket with a configured service type.
expected_result: Custom form is auto-attached based on the service type and flow.

title: Customer User Cannot Create SR
description: Ensure that a Customer User cannot create a Service Report.
steps_summary: Log in as a Customer User.
Attempt to access the Create Service Report action.
expected_result: Customer User cannot see or access the Create Service Report action.

title: SR Creation Against Non-Terminal Ticket
description: Ensure that an SR can only be created against a non-terminal ticket.
steps_summary: Open the Create Service Report form.
Attempt to select a terminal ticket (Closed, Resolved, Archived, Deleted).
expected_result: Terminal tickets do not appear in the Ticket dropdown.

title: SR Number Generation and Format
description: Verify that the SR number is generated according to the configured format and is unique.
preconditions: SR number format is configured in admin settings.
steps_summary: Open the Create Service Report form.
expected_result: SR number is generated according to the configured format and is unique.

title: Whitespace Only SR Name
description: Ensure that an SR Name consisting only of whitespace is treated as invalid.
steps_summary: Open the Create Service Report form.
Enter whitespace only in the SR Name field.
expected_result: Validation error is displayed for the SR Name field.

title: Duplicate SR Numbers on Simultaneous Creation
description: Ensure that simultaneous SR creations result in unique SR numbers.
steps_summary: Two users open the Create Service Report form simultaneously.
Both fill in all required fields.
Both submit the form at the same time.
expected_result: Each SR is assigned a unique, incremented SR number.

title: Direct URL Access by Customer User
description: Ensure that a Customer User cannot access the Create SR form via direct URL.
steps_summary: Log in as a Customer User.
Attempt to navigate directly to the Create SR URL.
expected_result: Customer User receives a 'Not Authorized' error or is redirected.

title: Verify Post-Creation State of SR
description: Ensure that the SR is in the correct state after creation.
steps_summary: Navigate to the SR detail view.
Verify the SR status, number, and linked entities.
expected_result: SR is in To Do status with correct number and linked entities.

title: SQL Injection in SR Name
description: Ensure that the system is protected against SQL injection attempts in the SR Name field.
steps_summary: Open the Create Service Report form.
Enter a SQL injection string in the SR Name field.
expected_result: System prevents SQL injection and displays a validation error.

title: Exceeding Max Length in SR Name
description: Ensure that the SR Name field handles input exceeding typical maximum length gracefully.
steps_summary: Open the Create Service Report form.
Enter a long string exceeding 500 characters in the SR Name field.
expected_result: System handles the input gracefully and displays a validation error if necessary.
